scripts.build: npm --workspace @eden/web run build && npm --workspace @eden/api run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @eden/web run typecheck && npm --workspace @eden/api run typecheck
scripts.validate: npm run validate:static && npm run build && node scripts/validate.mjs
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && npm --workspace @eden/api run deploy:dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && npm --workspace @eden/api run deploy:prod
